title: Tuning topological phases and exceptional points in a non-Hermitian Rice Mele model beyond nearest neighbors
summary: Exceptional points are degeneracies characteristic of non-Hermitian operators, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, rendering the Hamiltonian defective. We investigate the exceptional-point structure and topological properties of a generalized non-Hermitian Rice-Mele model with balanced gain and loss, as well as next-nearest-neighbor hopping. The system hosts only second-order exceptional points under both periodic and open boundary conditions.
